title: Fat Kid Rules the World
author: K. L. Going
current_text: Fat Kid Rules the World was removed from the Pickens County, S.C. middle- and high-school library shelves in 2007 because its language, sexual references, and drug use were considered inappropriate for middle-school students.

sources.quote:
Going, K. L.
Fat Kid Rules the World
Putnam
Removed from the Pickens County, S.C. middle- and high-school library shelves (2007) because "the language, the sexual references, and drug use are not appropriate for middle-school students."
